formula_observations: Aerosol. Propellant butane #1, propane #3, isobutane #4; alcohol denat. #2; isododecane #5 (volatile hydrocarbon carrier, dry-feel). OILS: 'Triheptanoin Camelina Stativa Seed Oil' #6 (published as one entry, no comma: synthetic triheptanoin ester plus camelina oil; the camelina-oil claim is carried by this entry) rank 6. FIXATIVES: Polyurethane-14 #8 and AMP-Acrylates Copolymer #10 (the classic film-former pair), both after Aqua #7 = low level, no hold claimed; role is film/anti-frizz seal, not hold. SILICONES: none (no 'ohne Silikone' claim printed on the dm page). SALTS/STARCHES/PARTICLES: none. Water is only #7. Only tail-end fragrance allergens and lemon peel oil.
notes: The only drugstore finishing spray found with an explicit humidity wording ('bei hoher Luftfeuchtigkeit'). Has a real film-former (Polyurethane-14 + AMP-Acrylates) but no hold claim and no Halt number, so it behaves as a shine/anti-frizz sealer, not a hairspray. Differs from Balea PROFESSIONAL Glow&Shine Finishing Spray (separate product, DAN 3165375, not in this lane). Contains oil ester but is not sold as Öl/Serum, so stays in Styling per D2.

formula_observations: Aerosol. Propellant dimethyl ether #1; alcohol denat. #2. OILS/EMOLLIENTS: C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate #3 and Hydrogenated Ethylhexyl Olivate #4 (olive-derived ester) lead the non-volatile part; Hydrogenated Olive Oil Unsaponifiables #8. notes: Boundary product: sold as dual-use 'Leave-In Spray' (damp heat-protect primer OR dry shine finish), brand explicitly says fix with Holding Me Strongly afterwards, i.e. the brand itself does not claim hold. Fixative + ester emollients + heat claim sits on the Styling/Leave-In/Heat-Protect borders (T15: fixative with thin conditioning = Styling). dm and Rossmann pages showed the item as temporarily unavailable at times (search snippets, unverified): re-check availability. The schwarzkopf.de page title is 'Shine Coat', dm title 'Glanz-Spray'.
